requirement.evidence: It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider.
requirement.note: Ban, the service-provider facilitation prohibition, reporting to the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations and the private right of action are all stated. The service-provider definition covers pooling nonpublic data and using computation to recommend prices, terms or occupancy.

key_value.evidence: Subsequent violations shall be punished by a fine of not less than $100 and up to $2000, as provided in Chapter 1, General Provisions, Art. I, § 1-25. Each day during which an owner is in violation of § 218-12 shall constitute a separate violation hereunder.
key_value.note: The $100-$2,000 range for subsequent violations and the per-day separate violation are stated. The card omits that a first violation is punished under § 1-25 with no amount given.

effective_date.evidence: Adopted on second and final reading after hearing on May 21 2025
effective_date.note: The document gives final passage on May 21, 2025 and states no effective date. 2025-06-10 comes from the 20-day default rule the card names (N.J.S.A. 40:69A-181(b)), which the document does not contain.

status.evidence: This is to certify that the foregoing Ordinance was adopted by the Municipal Council at its meeting on May 21 2025
status.note: The ordinance was adopted and approved by the mayor, and the document presents it as current law. It shows no repeal or amendment.

coverage.note: Coverage is empty on the card.

citation.evidence: §218-12 Preventing Algorithmic Rent Fixing in the Rental Housing Market:
